text:
anna: CI red on nightly-hosted-integ (shard-4). Failing suite: auth-handshake + streaming/toolcall schema. Can someone grab logs?

mike: on it. which shard run id?

anna: run id 2024-11-29_04-12 shard-4. quick log excerpt: ```ERROR AuthHandshake: 401 token validation failed (kid mismatch)
stack: auth/handler.go:142 -> session/rotate.go:58```

sre-bot: smoke-run summary: 3/5 shards failed. linked: https://ci.example/runs/2024-11-29_04-12 :warning:

lina: I can kick a rerun for shard-4 now, holding on until we have a quick triage.

raj: quick hypothesis — session key rotation rolled yesterday at ~03:00 UTC. Could be a stale kid cached in the test harness. @mike did we change the kid rotation logic?

mike: no code changes in prod auth, but infra applied key-rotate script. I'll grep the gateway logs for kid values.

anna: also seeing a separate failure in the toolcall integration: parser error from schema validation. snippet: ```{"tool_call": {"tool_id": null, "args": {}}} - expected string for tool_id```

lina: rerun kicked: https://ci.example/runs/2024-11-29_04-24 (shard-4 only). Will post results in 5-10m.

mike: gateway logs show intermittent 401s with kid: "k-20241128-v2" while auth service rotated to "k-20241129-v1". Looks like a caching window.

lina: rerun finished. auth-handshake still failing on shard-4, toolcall schema test passed this time (flaky).

raj: sounds like a windowed rotation issue. Can we reproduce locally by setting auth service to accept only new key? If so, bisect recent infra commits.

mike: starting bisect across infra/key-rotation commits: `git bisect start --bad HEAD --good origin/main~7` — queuing job on CI.

ci-bot: Bisect job #4532 queued for matrix (shard-1..5). ETA ~25m.

anna: thanks. If bisect points to the rotation script, we should revert the cron and patch the cache TTL. If not, escalate to infra oncall. I'll monitor and update. :thumbsup:
